Nottingham attack victim's death inquiry hears 'potentially preventable'

An inquiry into the Nottingham attacks heard that the death of a victim was 'potentially preventable'. The inquiry is examining the circumstances surrounding the June 2023 attacks, which left three people dead and several injured. Closing submissions are being made as the investigation concludes. Evidence presented suggested the killer had researched large venues and made notes about the Manchester Arena attack. Separately, it was reported that the killer's list of explosives was not disclosed by police to the inquiry.
